**Problem:** The HTTPRoute `app-route` referenced a non-existent Gateway named `app-gateway-missing` in its `parentRefs`, while the actual Gateway was named `app-gateway`. ```bash
kubectl patch httproute app-route --type=json -p '["{\"op\": \"replace\", \"path\": \"/spec/parentRefs/0/name\", \"value\": \"app-gateway\"}"]'
```

**Verification:**
- Gateway status now shows `attachedRoutes: 1` (was 0)
- HTTP requests through `http://<traefik-ip>/app` with Host header `app.example.com` successfully return a 200 OK response with the application content

End-to-end routing through `app.example.com` and path `/app` is now restored.
